text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa, haa, haa...!!
(WOOOOAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: That was an awesome race!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Everyone was so cool~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Yeah... I'm okay. I felt a real response back there.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(If I can keep building on this,
I'm sure...!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
W-Well then...!
If I may be so bold, I shall lead the cheers...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: C... cheers...!!
choice_data_list: Cheers! Great work at the Takarazuka Kinen!!

text_block_list.text:
Sometime after the Takarazuka Kinen.
On a rest day, we held a modest gathering
to celebrate and appreciate Zenno Rob Roy's hard work.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your hard work, Trainer!
Thank you so much for supporting me throughout this spring.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Still, to buy so many snacks and juices for us...
Ah, there are carrot chips too! Waaah..."
choice_data_list: Because I worked so hard this spring!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I'm being spoiled somehow...
No, but... it makes me happy.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The spring racing season is already coming to an end, isn't it?
...I wonder how much of a name I made for myself.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That's right.
I heard there's a racing program today covering the highlights from this spring!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The timing is just right...
Shall we watch it now?
choice_data_list: (So you put together a highlight reel...)

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Still!! That's exactly why you can't help but get your hopes up!
This time for sure! If it's her, she can do it!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: They're saying she'll definitely set a grand record worthy of the title "Great King"...!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer-san?
Um... excuse me, was there another program
you wanted to watch?

I shake off the sudden, creeping premonition.
...Zenno Rob Roy truly did her absolute best.
Being right beside her, I should know that better than anyone.

If I don't believe in the path I've walked—that it was well worth acknowledging—then who will?
...With that thought in mind, I turned on the TV.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
—Well, we've looked back over the spring season so far,
and now we're finally at the grand finale: the Takarazuka Kinen.
What were your thoughts on it?

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
It truly was another great race this year!
Grand Prix races really are the best.

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"I hope more and more glamorous Umamusume keep joining the fray
and making things even more exciting."

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! Now then, speaking
of things being glamorous—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: When it comes to the Umamusume who made the biggest headlines this spring season, it simply has to be her!!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it's etched deeply into the hearts of every racing fan.
The Nippon Derby, the "Descent of the Supreme Great King"!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
No, that was truly a heated race...! And claiming
the historic first consecutive sweep from the NHK Mile Cup
to the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby)! An epic, historic achievement!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
6 wins in 7 starts so far, with the only loss
still being an impressive 3rd-place finishâan incredible record, yetâ

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: Setting record times in both the NHK Mile Cup and the Tokyo Yushun—what sheer bravery! You really couldn't take your eyes off the Classic class this spring!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Her overwhelming "speed" and "strength"
will surely be talked about in the racing world
for a long time to come, don't you think—?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
It really was an incredible spectacle,
this year's Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
Oh, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Please don't make such a face.
It would be terrible if the wrinkle between
your eyebrows became permanent.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you for worrying and
thinking so hard on my behalf."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
To care so much... about me. Th-That's...
Ehehe, putting it into words makes me even more embarrassed.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Still... Trainer.
I'll be fine, really.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes! ...After all, I've been used to staying out of the spotlight ever since I was born!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"I won't panic now after all this.
...Of course, I do feel a little frustrated, though."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Still, this is a frustration I can turn into strength. ...I'll channel it into power and keep building myself up.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Step by step, steadily...
My stubbornness really begins... from here on out!
choice_data_list: I see... Now you're the one encouraging me.
I see... Now you're the one encouraging me.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
What?! That's...
That's... wow...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no!
Um, I was just thinking about how you're always there supporting me... that's all.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...It made me feel so proud. ...Ehehe.

After that, we turned off the TV
and enjoyed a modest feast with Zenno Rob Roy
while looking back on the spring season.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, Trainer.
Would it be okay if our next goal is the Tenno Sho (Autumn)?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The royal road of the Fall Senior route... indeed.
If I am to build my legend as a hero,
I figured this was the place to do it.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Even if it's little by little, I want to become someone you can acknowledge...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much.
Well then... first up is summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best step by step every day.
Please continue to be... sp-spartan with me this year as well, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (I'm okay. I will be fine.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(If I can just keep steadily, surely building upon this...
Someday, I'll definitely become a hero—)
